worldcombat.skill.blazekick.summary: Spin up and swing a flame-wreathed leg in a rising arc: a hit deals contact damage, may set the target burning, and launches it off the ground so it cannot act until it lands. Ignite form burns more often and launches higher; Heavy form kicks harder but leaves fire less often.
The kick deals %1$s contact damage to the target, with a reach of %2$s blocks.
On a hit the target is launched %1$s blocks off the ground; the flame arc opens %2$s blocks wide.
On a hit there is a %1$s chance to leave the target burning for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.ignite.on: Ignite form: burn chance +12%%, burn duration x1.2 and a higher launch; costs kick power x0.88 and +4 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.ignite.off: Heavy form: a harder kick on a faster loop; costs fire that is harder to leave and a slightly lower launch.
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.timing: Range %1$s, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.growth.0: From level %1$s the kick power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.growth.1: From level %1$s the kick power is %2$s and the burn chance rises to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.use.0: An upward flaming kick that launches the target
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.use.1: Interrupt a close foe and set it alight
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.use.2: Lift a target so it cannot act until it lands
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.preference.i: On: burn chance +12%%, burn duration x1.2, higher launch, but kick power x0.88 and +4 cooldown - for leaving fire behind. Off (Heavy form): a harder kick on a faster loop, but fire is harder to leave and the launch is lower.
worldcombat.skill.blazekick.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in first; the kick reach is short, so a large value often still cannot reach.
When on, a target not already burning ranks higher so a heavy kick is not just a refresh; when off all targets rank alike.
